### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Phone payment fee on b0776116** (statement_period 2026-09, posting_date 2026-09-30, entered 2026-10-16).
- Baseline (`Charges Entry — Agent-Assisted Phone Payment Fee`): "the plan's phone payment fee, charged as a flat amount" → 7.95 (Schedule: Fixed-Rate 120 phone fee 7.95); "The payment named is the most recent payment taken through a phone agent".
- Reliance: not enrolled; phone-agent payments in the 12 months before 2026-10-16, named included = 3 → "12.95".
- Size: named 340.00 < 396.30 → "the lower of the fee and the small-payment share of 3% of the payment" → min(12.95, 10.20) = 10.20.
- Discount program (senior on the financed window contract) ×90%; household (no door contract, active CareLine Plus) ×95%; "only the final fee is rounded".
- 10.20 × 0.90 × 0.95 = 8.721 → **8.72**. Fall-back: **7.95**.
- Composition note: the two share docs speak of "The phone payment fee charged", i.e. the figure after the reliance/size rules; the alternative order (shares before the 3% comparison) gives min(11.07, 10.20) × … = 10.20 unmultiplied — not supported by the share docs' wording.

**(b) Late fee for statement period 2026-09** (assessed 2026-10-16). Due 2026-09-12, grace 15 days (Schedule) → last grace day 2026-09-27; only 340.00 posted 2026-09-30 → "not posted in full by the end of the plan's grace period" → one late fee owed. 2026-10 (grace to 2026-10-27) not yet late; 2026-07 re-paid 07-20 within grace (last grace day 07-27).
- Baseline (`Late Fee Worksheet`): min(35.00, 5% × 396.30 = 19.82) = 19.82.
- Late fees standing (6 months): 0 → fixed late fee 15.00.
- Project size: 35077.80 ≥ 30000.00 → share 3.5% → 13.87.
- Arrears standing: periods 49 − deferred 0 − covered 47 [(19362.40 − 396.30)/396.30 = 47.86 → 47] = 2 → "the higher of the fixed late fee and the share figure" → 15.00.
- Shares: senior ×90%; CareLine ×95% (no closed cash door contract); tenure 47 ≥ 36 → ×90%. 15.00 × 0.7695 = 11.5425 → **11.54**.
- Fall-back: **19.82**.

**(c) Catch-up payment** (paid 2026-10-16).
- Baseline (`Amortization Note — Catch-Up Payment Amount`): balance less the scheduled balance after min(47 + 1, 49) = 48 payments at 9.99%/12. Balance after the two fees: 21480.17 + 8.72 + 11.54 = 21500.43; scheduled balance 21396.00 → **104.43** (fall-back).
- Arrears method (`Collections Guidance: Catch-Up Figure and Arrears`): 2 behind → unpaid part 396.30 × 49 − 18966.10 = 452.60 + fee pool. Fee pool = late/returned/phone fees posted in the three months before the payment less reversals: 6.80 (2026-08-12) + 8.72 (dated 2026-09-30) + 11.54 (2026-10-16) = 27.06; the 30.00 returned-payment fee of 2026-07-15 is outside (window begins 2026-07-16). Figure 479.66.
- Reliefs (added together): senior 25% + CareLine 15% (household) + tenure 47 ≥ 36 → 10% + returned record (1 return in 12 months) 5% = 55%; relief 0.55 × 27.06 = 14.883 → 14.88 (≤ pool).
- Catch-up **464.78**, credited to the oldest statement period it brings current = **2026-09** (47 covered → 48th period from 2022-10 is 2026-09).

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials

Root: the catch-up payment (`Ridgeline Online Portal Catch-Up Payment…`).
- Hop A — **state-derived**. "A catch-up payment is fixed only after the account carries the late fee owed for every statement period whose scheduled payment stayed unpaid past its grace period." Records: no late-fee entry; 2026-09 unpaid past grace. Search "late fee … statement period … grace period" → `Posting a Late Fee on … Fixed-Rate or Low-Payment Account`: "posted as a late-fee entry naming that statement period" → agent posts.
- Hop B — **state-derived**. "A catch-up payment is not figured until the most recent payment taken through a phone agent carries its phone payment fee." Records: b0776116 (phone_agent) has no fee naming it. Search "phone payment fee … payment taken through a phone agent" → `Agent-Assisted Phone Payment Fee…`: "booked … as a new phone-payment fee entry … naming the payment taken through a phone agent" → agent posts.
- Neither the late-fee posting nor the phone-fee doc carries a prerequisite sentence → tree stops. Order {A, B} before root; A/B unordered.

### Counter-proofs

- "Do only what was asked" (quote a figure now): the two sentences forbid fixing/figuring before both fee records exist; a figure quoted now would also omit 20.26 of the fee pool.
- Crediting 2026-10: excluded — "credited to the oldest statement period it brings current"; 47 covered of 49 due.
- Charging the phone fee for the 2026-08-12 payment: excluded — it already carries 527fa15c and the named payment is "the most recent payment taken through a phone agent".
- A late fee for 2026-07: excluded — re-payment 2026-07-20 within the grace ("a payment posted on the last grace day is on time"); a returned payment counts unpaid "as if it had never posted", but the re-payment posted before 2026-07-27.
- Lower-of combination for the late fee: excluded by "two or more payments behind takes the higher".
- Including the 2026-07-15 returned-payment fee in the pool: excluded by "posted in the three months before the payment".
